svg.title: Connection pooling
svg.desc: Serverless functions each open their own Postgres connection until the count reaches 100 and function 800 is refused because no slots are free. Then PgBouncer sits in between: each request borrows one of a few pooled connections, runs its query, and hands it back, so Postgres holds only 40.
svg.text: Direct connections hit the limit. PgBouncer shares 40 of them.
